criteria.text: The participant is a female of childbearing potential who has not undergone a hysterectomy or bilateral oophorectomy and has not been naturally postmenopausal for at least 12 consecutive months

source.text:
A female of childbearing potential is a sexually mature female who:

  * Has not undergone a hysterectomy or bilateral oophorectomy; or
  * Has not been naturally postmenopausal for at least 12 consecutive months (i.e., has had menses at any time in the preceding 12 consecutive months)

criteria.text: Local testing of EGFR shows no EGFR exon 19 deletion or EGFR L858 R mutation

source.text: Local testing of EGFR with no EGFR exon 19 deletion or EGFR L858 R mutation (applicable to non-squamous patients only)

criteria.text: Local testing of ALK shows no ALK rearrangement

source.text: Local testing of ALK with no ALK rearrangement (failed testing is considered negative) (applicable to non-squamous patients only)

criteria.text: Local testing of PD-L1 immunohistochemistry (IHC) is performed using one of the following assays: DAKO 22C3, DAKO 28-8, EIL3N or SP263

source.text: Local testing of PD-L1 immunohistochemistry (IHC) using one of the following assays: DAKO 22C3, DAKO 28-8, EIL3N or SP263

criteria.text: The participant has completely resected stage IIA, IIB, IIIA or IIIB (T3-4N2) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (squamous or non-squamous) with negative margins (complete R0 resection), staged according to the 8th edition of the American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) Staging Manual, 2017, and is not known to have N2 disease prior to surgery

source.text:
Completely resected stage IIA, IIB IIIA or IIIB (T3-4N2) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (squamous or non-squamous) with negative margins (complete R0 resection). Patients will be staged according to the 8th edition of the American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) Staging Manual, 2017

  * Note: Patients with pathologic N2 disease, completely resected, are eligible. However, patients known to have N2 disease prior to surgery are not eligible; guidelines do not recommend up-front surgery for this population

criteria.text: The participant has completely recovered from surgery and registration to A081801 occurs 30-77 days following surgery

source.text: Complete recovery from surgery. Registration to A081801 must be 30-77 days following surgery

criteria.text: The participant has had no prior neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy for the current lung cancer diagnosis

source.text: No prior neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy for current lung cancer diagnosis

criteria.text: The participant has had no prior allogeneic tissue or solid organ transplant

source.text: No prior allogeneic tissue/solid organ transplant

criteria.text: The participant does not have an uncontrolled intercurrent illness including serious ongoing or active infection, symptomatic congestive heart failure, uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia, or unstable angina pectoris that would limit compliance with study requirements

source.text: Patients must NOT have uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, serious ongoing or active infection, symptomatic congestive heart failure, uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia, unstable angina pectoris, that would limit compliance with study requirements

criteria.text: The participant has no current pneumonitis or history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis that required steroids

source.text: No current pneumonitis or history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis that required steroids

criteria.text: The participant is a human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected patient on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months

source.text: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected patients on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months are eligible for this trial

criteria.text: The participant is age >= 18 years

source.text: Age \>= 18 years

criteria.text: The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) of 0-1

source.text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS): 0-1

criteria.text: The participant has no active auto-immune disease that has required systemic treatment within the last 2 years

source.text: No active auto-immune disease that has required systemic treatment within the last 2 years (e.g., disease-modifying agents, corticosteroids, or immunosuppressive drugs). Replacement therapy (e.g., thyroxine, insulin, or physiologic corticosteroid release therapy for adrenal or pituitary insufficiency) is not considered a form of systemic treatment

criteria.text: The participant is not pregnant and not nursing, and for women of childbearing potential, a negative pregnancy test done <= 7 days prior to registration is required

source.text:
Not pregnant and not nursing, because this study involves an agent that has known genotoxic, mutagenic and teratogenic effects

  * Therefore, for women of childbearing potential only, a negative pregnancy test done =\< 7 days prior to registration is required

criteria.text: The participant has no "currently active" second malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the last 3 years, but participants with non-melanoma skin cancers, low grade or low-risk cancers, or stage I malignancies not requiring systemic therapy, or carcinoma in situ that have undergone potentially curative therapy are eligible

source.text: No patients with a "currently active" second malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the last 3 years. Participants with non-melanoma skin cancers, low grade or low-risk cancers, or stage I malignancies not requiring systemic therapy (e.g., prostate cancer requiring only observation or superficial bladder cancer), or carcinoma in situ (e.g., breast carcinoma or cervical cancer in situ) that have undergone potentially curative therapy are eligible

criteria.text: The participant has no hypersensitivity (>= grade 3) to pembrolizumab and/or any of its excipients

source.text: No hypersensitivity (\>= grade 3) to pembrolizumab and/or any of its excipients

criteria.text: The participant has received no live vaccine within 30 days prior to registration

source.text: No live vaccine within 30 days prior to registration. Examples of live vaccines include, but are not limited to, the following: measles, mumps, rubella, varicella/zoster (chicken pox), yellow fever, rabies, Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG), and typhoid vaccine. Seasonal influenza vaccines for injection are generally killed virus vaccines and are allowed; however, intranasal influenza vaccines (e.g., FluMist) are live attenuated vaccines and are not allowed

criteria.text: The participant has no known hepatitis C virus infection or known history of hepatitis B

source.text: No known hepatitis C virus (defined as HCV ribonucleic acid \[RNA\] \[qualitative\] is detected) infection or known history of hepatitis B (defined as hepatitis B surface antigen \[HBsAg\] reactive)

criteria.text: The participant has an absolute neutrophil count (ANC) >= 1,500/mm^3

source.text: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) \>= 1,500/mm\^3

criteria.text: The participant has a platelet count >= 100,000/mm^3

source.text: Platelet count \>= 100,000/mm\^3

criteria.text: The participant has a hemoglobin >= 8 gm/dl

source.text: Hemoglobin \>= 8 gm/dl

criteria.text: The participant has a calculated creatinine clearance >= 45 mL/min

source.text: Calculated (Calc.) creatinine clearance \>= 45 mL/min

source.text: Total bilirubin =\< 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN)
